items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 26 at 6:10AM EDT until September 27 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 6 to 11 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Cape Hatteras to Ocracoke
Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Moderate winds and elevated seas will
continue to impact the coastal and offshore waters as a
Nor'easter moves slowly north off the Mid-Atlantic Coast.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
